name: Yes Bank Ltd
title: Yes Bank Ltd - 532648 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Yes Bank exits FY26 at ~1% ROA with NIM 2.7% and GNPA 1.3%, but advances growth of 11% and a 14-15% FY27 target are the swing factors; RIDF rundown to ~INR 28,000 cr is a margin tailwind.

triggers.label: NIM 2.7% up 10bps QoQ
triggers.quote: our NIM saw an improvement of 10 basis points quarter -on-quarter and 20 basis points year -on-year and came in at a number of 2.7%

triggers.label: RIDF rundown INR 6,500-9,000 cr FY27
triggers.quote: We think that next year, at a minimum, the reduction should be about INR 6,500 crores. That could also go as high as INR 9,000 crores by the end of March '27.

triggers.label: Yield on advances 9.2% at March exit
triggers.quote: for yield on advances that we've had as we look to exit March, that has been about 9.2%

triggers.label: Advances growth 11% YoY, accelerating
triggers.quote: that's kind of ending up with a reported number of 11% on a Y-o-Y basis for Advances growth

triggers.label: Structural NIM 3.25-3.5% in 2-3 years
triggers.quote: we do believe that we will want to get into a 3.25% to 3.5% kind of a range from a margin perspective

guidance.quote: our expectation is that should be in the 13% to 15% range

guidance.value: INR 6,500 cr minimum, up to INR 9,000 cr
guidance.quote: the reduction should be about INR 6,500 crores. That could also go as high as INR 9,000 crores
we do believe that we will want to get into a 3.25% to 3.5% kind of a range from a margin perspective

guidance.value: 25-50 bps over 2-3 years ex JC Flowers write-backs
guidance.quote: we will look to improve our ROA 25 to 50 basis points
a plan of around 400 branches with an average of around 80 branches per annum

prior_guidance_check.quote: In line with our guidance, Bank reported an ROA for the quarter of 1%.

prior_guidance_check.metric: SR recoveries FY26 guidance INR 1,200 cr
prior_guidance_check.quote: recoveries from Security Receipts (SRs) of a little more than INR 1,550 crores against our guidance of INR 1,200 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: NIM improvement in line with guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: in line with our guidance given in Q4 of FY25
We also opened 82 new branches during the year, which was in line with our guidance at the start of the year.

prior_guidance_check.metric: RIDF/PSL mandated deposits below 5% by FY27
prior_guidance_check.quote: the Bank remains well on track to reduce these Deposit balances to below 5% by fiscal '27

red_flags.label: INR 341 cr one-time standard asset provision
red_flags.quote: that application we have done in quarter 4 of this year, which translates to about INR 341 crores

red_flags.label: AT1 bond case pending at Supreme Court
red_flags.quote: this matter is subjudice, as you all know. The hearings have taken place at the Supreme Court, and the matter is also reserved for judgment

red_flags.label: Retail slippage ~2.9% and SR recoveries falling
red_flags.quote: Retail Slippages, while they are improving, they are still 2.93%

evasions.topic: AT1 bond case outcome and balance-sheet impact
evasions.quote: I would refrain from passing a judgment on what we expect.
we usually refrain from giving the near -term guidance
